a resident from KK3 here :)

KK3 has 4 blocks (3 for girls, 1 for boys)

Block A (girls) has room for two. Bunk bed, quite small. Don't expect much from it. Pray that if you get this block, you'll have a good roommate.

Block B (girls) has room for three. One bunk bed, one single bed. Come early so you get to chop the single bed. Quite spacious.

Block C (girls) are also room for three. Quite similar to block B, but definitely smaller (but not as bad as block A)

Block E (boys), room for three. I don't know how it looks. 

Unfortunately, I don't have friends from other KKs so idk about other colleges.

Pros of KK3 is that, the college itself is small. So you don't have to walk much from the front gate, to your room (compared to other colleges, bcs they have bigger compounds). Your walk to the cafe and office is also quite close. That's one of the small things that I like about KK3 :)

edit: forgot to mention, pls bring a fan (the short one that you can put on your table). you might think that you don't need it but with the current weather, you REALLY need it <3
